hypotheses.scope: Side prediction conditional on observed symbols and complete archived x5 Cross flows; not cross-sectional coin selection or complete entry rule.
hypotheses.threshold_origin: Natural zero-return signs after bounded development review. H1/H2 positive association 18/30 and 20/30; daily H3 16/30 as daily schedule reference. All are weak on development and retained as explicit limited checks; no side-specific window fitting.
hypotheses.side_mapping: Positive return -> Long; negative -> Short; zero gives no prediction and fails. Identical window/mapping on both sides.
hypotheses.background: 12 same-symbol windows 2-24h before entry, compared with the actual entry side held fixed; dependent reference frequency, not labeled background direction decisions or false signals.
hypotheses.symbol_selection: Not recovered: historical eligible universe and labeled nonentries unavailable; no ranks or precision claims.
hypotheses.unknown_policy: No post-holdout tuning. First orderTime only. Additional entries/exits and avgCost not used as signals. No claim of profitability.

independent_verification.method: Independent Fraction complete-flow selection and Decimal return direction, raw/freeze/day/side-screen checks
